page.layout: One column of running text below two engraved coin medallions at the top. The medallions are illustrations with legends; they are described in notes. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: BALISTA utrum imperarit ambigitur: sunt qui dicant Quieto per Odenatum occiso, Balistæ veniam datam: attamen eum imperasse, quòd nec Gallieno, nec Aureolo, nec Odenato se crederet. Alij asserunt priuatum in agro suo interemptum. Multi & sumpsisse illũ purpuram, & more Romano imperasse, ac exercitum duxisse. Fuit vir quidem insignis, valuit consilio: expeditionibus & prouisione annonaria singularis. Gratias egit Balistæ Valerianus per epistolã, in qua docet sibi præcepta gu-bernandæ reipub. ab hoc data, gaudens quòd eius consilio nul-lum adscriptitium, id est vacãtem haberet, & Tribunũ nullum stipatorem qui non verè pugnaret. Hic nihilominus in tetorio[?] suo cubans, à quodã gregario milite Odenati, in Gallieni gra-tiam dicitur interemptus. Vide Treb. Pol.

VALENS, militaris vir, simul etiam ciuilium virtutũ glo-ria pollens, Proconsulatũ Achaiæ, dato à Gallieno tunc hono-re administrabat: quem Macrianus vehementer reformidans, misso Pisone interfici præcepit. At valens sibi diligentissimè ca-uens, nec aliter sibi posse subueniri existimãs, sumpsit Imperiũ, & breui à militibus interemptus est. Fuit & alter Valens, huius auunculus, sed par in ambobus fuit fortuna: nã & ille cũ pau-cis diebus Illyrico imperasset, occisus est. Vide vt supra.

page.notes: Engraved medallions at top: left coin legend "BALISTA PF AVG" (around the rim, with "PF" and "AVG" at the edges); right coin legend "IMP AVG VALENS" (around the rim). These are part of the engravings and are not transcribed as text. "tetorio" is printed as such and is probably a misprint for "tectorio"; left as printed, marked [?]. Signature "Eec 2" is read from the scan; the third letter could be an e or a c, copied as seen. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Running head and signature are printed as shown.
